name: Closing Door Prank: Sprint at the Door Before It Shuts
blurb: The closing door prank, also called the fake closing door prank or the close the door prank, is a TikTok trend from late October 2026: someone counts down, the runner sprints down a hallway at an open door, and the door swings shut just as they get there.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 9 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: an ordinary home hallway with a white door standing open in the middle of the frame, a long bright corridor behind it, a wooden floor, a woman on the left holding the door's edge, one fixed phone camera. The same framing, cut, timing and moves. The ONLY change: the runner, the man who sprints down the corridor, is now the person in [Image 1]. Only replace the runner; keep the action, the motion path and the background unchanged. Keep everything else the same.

The runner = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY shot: keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, body and clothes. Copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. If [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally. The same real person from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also far down the corridor and on the floor. Never morph, never drift back to the original runner's face. NO black beard and NO short curly black hair unless [Image 1] shows them; no brown sweater with a white collar unless [Image 1] shows it.

The woman at the door keeps her own face, hair, clothes and moves exactly as in [Video 1].

Shot 1 [0-6.6s], one fixed take:
00:00-00:01.8: the woman stands on the left beside the open white door and counts down; the runner waits far away at the end of the bright corridor.
00:01.8-00:03.2: on "go" the runner sprints down the corridor toward the open door.
00:03.2-00:05.0: just as the runner reaches it, the woman swings the white door toward shut; the runner throws one arm up and squeezes through the narrowing gap.
00:05.0-00:06.6: the runner bursts out on the near side of the door, right in front of the camera, knees bent, both hands up in front of the chest, eyes wide, as if they ran straight through the closing door, then drops onto both knees.
Shot 2 [6.6-9s], hard cut, the same fixed camera: the runner slides on the knees across the wooden floor toward the right, one hand on the floor, then sits back and looks up at the door, laughing; the woman peeks out from behind the door at the left edge, laughing.

ONLY THE MOTION OF [Video 1]: nobody does a move the people in [Video 1] do not do. The door never hits the runner: the runner always gets through.

Real live-action footage, natural indoor light, casual family-video look. Plain clothes with no printed text. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.

Anatomy rules: one head per body, two arms, five fingers on each hand. No face on knees, hands, clothes or the door. Exactly two people. No text, captions, logos or watermark anywhere.
